title: Nextdoor Announces 2026 Fave Award Winners, Celebrating Neighborhood Favorites
summary: Nextdoor announces the 2026 Fave Award winners, highlighting the most loved local businesses based on millions of neighbor votes across the U.S.
body_markdown:
*Millions of neighbor votes recognize the local businesses communities love, with winners featured in their neighborhood’s Local Faves hub*


SAN FRANCISCO--October 14, 2026 - Nextdoor Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: NXDR), the essential neighborhood network, today announced the U.S. winners of the 2026 Fave Awards, recognizing the local businesses neighbors love most. Winners were decided by neighbor voting, making this year’s list incredibly useful. Votes cast by neighbors between Sept. 4 and Sept. 30 were counted, and the full winners list is live at


[nextdoor.com/fave_awards_winners](http://nextdoor.com/fave_awards_winners) .


Nextdoor neighbors in the U.S. cast about 5 million votes for about 750,000 local businesses across 20 categories. Neighborhoods across the U.S. now have their own lists of the businesses their neighbors rely on most. Fave Awards are given once a year, and voting starts fresh each time.


What sets the Fave Awards apart is where the recommendations come from: neighbors in the communities where these businesses operate. Instead of a single national ranking or anonymous reviews from across the internet, the awards reflect local word of mouth, so each neighborhood gets its own list of businesses, from restaurants to plumbers, that its neighbors know and trust. Businesses cannot pay Nextdoor for Faves or votes, and no purchase or payment of any kind increases a business’s chance of winning. The recognition comes from neighbors.


"Congratulations to all of this year's Fave Awards winners," said Nirav Tolia, Nextdoor CEO and Co-Founder. "Every business on these lists was voted in by the neighbors who live around it. That is a high bar, and the ones who cleared it have earned the trust and loyalty of their community."


Top-voted winners include


[Stan’s Donut Shop](https://nextdoor.com/pages/stans-donut-shop-santa-clara-ca/) in Santa Clara, Calif.;


[Tower Cafe](https://nextdoor.com/page/tower-cafe-sacramento-ca/) in Sacramento, Calif.;


[Round Rock Donuts](https://nextdoor.com/pages/round-rock-donuts/) in Round Rock, Texas;


[Portofino Pizza and Pasta](https://nextdoor.com/pages/portofino-pizza-and-pasta-parker-co-2/) in Parker, Colo.; and


[Original Word of Mouth](https://nextdoor.com/page/original-word-of-mouth-venice-fl/) in Venice, Fla.


While the Fave Awards are held once a year, businesses can collect Faves year-round, with each Fave signaling that a neighbor vouches for their business on Nextdoor. The more Faves a business has, the more that business stands out in Search and in the Local Faves hub on Nextdoor. Faves on Nextdoor now number nearly 78 million in the U.S.


For businesses that earn a Fave Award, the recognition goes even further. Winners receive a Fave Awards trophy badge that appears on their Nextdoor Business Page and higher ranking in neighbor search results, whether or not they have claimed their page. Winners will also receive a storefront sticker and a downloadable Winner's Kit, so they can share the news with their own customers.


Neighbors can see the winners for their area by logging in to Nextdoor or visiting


[nextdoor.com/fave_awards_winners.](http://nextdoor.com/fave_awards_winners) You can learn more about the Nextdoor Fave Awards by visiting:


[https://business.nextdoor.com/en-us/small-business/fave-awards](https://business.nextdoor.com/en-us/small-business/fave-awards) .


**About Nextdoor** **** Nextdoor (Nasdaq: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network for over 110 million verified neighbors, offering trusted local news, real-time safety alerts, neighbor recommendations, for sale and free listings, and events. Nextdoor connects neighbors to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities. In addition, businesses, news publishers, and public agencies use Nextdoor to share important information and engage with neighborhoods at scale. Download the app or join the neighborhood at


[nextdoor.com](http://nextdoor.com/) . For more information and media assets, visit


[nextdoor.com/newsroom](http://nextdoor.com/newsroom) .
